plugins.name: roundtable
plugins.description: Multi-model consensus MCP server. Dispatches one prompt to the local Antigravity, Copilot, Codex, and Claude CLIs in parallel — and to any configured OpenAI-compatible HTTP providers — then returns every response as structured JSON for synthesis. Tools: roundtable-canvass, roundtable-deliberate, roundtable-blueprint, roundtable-critique, roundtable-crosscheck, roundtable-converge. Installing this plugin registers the MCP server (via .mcp.json) and the roundtable usage skill together; the roundtable binary must be on PATH (see INSTALL.md).
